method.dedup: (round ref, ordered roster); compare public events/results; no hidden cards used
method.postflop: Response to street first bet while still exactly one bet/raise; sizes are original bet added / pot BEFORE bet; HU/multiway at bet time
method.preflop: RFI opportunity means no raise and no prior limper. Fold-to-single-open includes cold/limp responses; opener-facing-first-reraise measured separately. Blind late-open defence uses clean CO/BTN/SB opens.
method.uncertainty: Wilson95 describes opportunity rates, not independent-hand formal inference; actions cluster by table/hand; profits descriptive only.
method.sourceGroups: external and own subgroups overlap on the duplicate table seen from both perspectives; do not sum subgroup exposures. Global profiles count each unique table once.
